findings.item: HSV urgent-communication FA optionC and wrongExplanations.C
findings.observed: درمان عفونی is awkward and درمان تجربی ضدعفونی reads like empirical disinfection rather than anti-infective therapy.
findings.requiredCorrection: Use natural درمان ضدعفونت or, in the HSV-specific sentence, درمان تجربی ضدویروسی. Preserve the distinction between parallel EEG and prompt empirical treatment.

findings.observed: An arterial TOF-MRA-centred study is off-task rather than a plausible competing structural/tissue protocol for a ring lesion.
findings.requiredCorrection: Replace with a credible partial conventional MRI protocol for the same ring-lesion question, and explain the missing contribution of DWI/ADC or pre/postcontrast assessment. Retain one best answer.

findings.observed: The linked EAN/ESCMID2026 guideline and Chow2015 cohort are explicitly adult sources, but current new vignettes and empirical-treatment card do not state adult scope.
findings.requiredCorrection: Specify adult patients in the new HSV cases and relevant treatment card/source note. Do not generalise adult guidance to neonatal encephalitis.

findings.observed: The front asks only whether the MRI proves HSV; learners can begin with a reflex no rather than retrieving the confirmatory method/timing caveat.
findings.requiredCorrection: Prefer a short how/what prompt asking which etiological test complements the pattern and why timing matters. Existing answer content can remain.

Original17ring-lesion diffusion cohort abstract and methods/results: central restriction supports abscess but metastasis exception and nonrestricting abscess present; no invented sensitivity.
